name: The Lebedyn Executions (1708–1709) (C0013)

techniques.comment: The destruction of the political leadership that supported the hetman: "the entire (!) general starshyna" followed Mazepa, and of the Left-Bank colonels only four remained loyal to the tsar(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011). The investigation of the officers was directed from the tsar's headquarters, where "being at Lebedyn and Sumy, Peter and Menshikov in January 1709" oversaw the reprisals(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011). The ecclesiastical punishment was arranged by the tsar's direct order - by a letter of 31 October 1708 (No. 2795) Peter I instructed metropolitan Stefan Yavorsky: "be pleased to have him, for such a deed of his, publicly cursed in the cathedral church..."(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011)(Citation: Письма и бумаги императора Петра Великого. Т. VIII, вып. 1 (июль-декабрь 1708 г.) 1948).

Intimidation of the population by an exemplary reprisal against an entire town: during the capture of Baturyn "in the bloody massacre and fire a multitude of the town's defenders and inhabitants perished"(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011), "the town was razed to the ground and its inhabitants annihilated," and the returning residents were charged a special tax "for treason"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 1 2003). The devastation of the hetman capital also destroyed the state archive of the Hetmanate, which suffered "during the storming of Baturyn castle by A. Menshikov in 1708"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 1 2003).
